infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Attendance uses your location when you check in or out to confirm you're at your assigned work location.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Attendance can automatically check you out when you leave your assigned work location, so you don't have to remember to do it yourself. This only runs while you're checked in.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Attendance uses Face ID to lock the app when you enable it in your profile, so only you can open it.
